## WO-2026-00004 — Grain Cart Ladder Guard Weldment (80 pcs)

**One correction to the premise first:** WO-2026-00004 is not holding up WO-2026-00001. Both are late and both are stuck at the same first operation, but they are separate make-to-order jobs — WO-2026-00001 is the Combine Header Auger Bracket Assembly (120 pcs), and it does not consume WO-2026-00004's output. The platform's BOM walk over open work orders found **no** work orders consuming WO-2026-00004 (potentially_blocked_work_orders is empty), and WO-2026-00004's item FG-GRD-1150 is consumed in no BOM at all — it only appears as the output of BOM-2026-00004. So there is no downstream WO dependency to confirm. WO-2026-00001 is late in its own right (is_late=true, 56 days past due), and I've flagged the cause separately below.

### Why late (WO-2026-00004)
- is_late = **true**, 65 days past its planned end of 2026-08-15; status not_started, 0 of 80 produced, no projected finish date.
- Stuck at **JC-2026-00013, "Laser Cut", workstation LASER-01 — 6kW Fiber Laser**, open, never started, waiting 129 days (planned start 2026-06-12). The three later cards (JC-2026-00014 Form/Brake, JC-2026-00015 Robotic Weld, JC-2026-00016 Powder Coat) are all still open too.
- Contributing signals only — **no blocking signal** (no material, subcontract or quality hold): `not_started_past_planned_start`, `schedule_capacity_ceiling` on WS-2026-00001 (720 min), `operation_not_started`, and recorded downtime on the route workstations: WELD-03 1,320 min / 6 entries (2 breakdown, 2 tool change, 2 material shortage), BRAKE-02 480 min (operator unavailable), COAT-06 300 min (setup change), LASER-01 210 min (material shortage, quality issue).
- Costs: expected and actual are both 0.00 USD — no cost recorded, so no variance is computed.

### What it blocks
- **SO-2026-00003**, customer Tri-State Farm Equipment, delivery date 2026-06-09, value **USD 158,929.52**, undelivered — linked directly on WO-2026-00004 (`confidence: linked`), so this is recorded exposure. customer_impact = "known".
- No potential consumers were found, so no potential exposure to report.

### Rescheduling
A proposal exists but this seat **cannot write it**: new start 2026-10-19 → new end 2026-12-22 (earliest start after known blockers, finish from finite schedule), `writable_by_seat = false` — "status 'not_started': dates are locked after submit; changing them needs an admin cancel." Treat it as a recommendation for a planner/admin, not a change I made. I attempted to escalate it for the admin cancel, but **no escalation was raised (raised=false, no assignee assigned)** — a planner or admin at Keystone Precision Works must action the date change directly.

### Not visible to me
Nothing is hidden from this seat for these records. Separately, on the shop-floor sweep the **shortages** and **automation_failures** lanes came back permission_denied — those two lanes are unknown, not clear. What I could read: 14 high-severity quality blocks (2 on open orders, e.g. QI-2026-00002 on WO-2026-00002) and 7 high-severity subcontract blocks (0 on open orders).

**Suggested action:** the binding item is the locked date on WO-2026-00004, not a material shortage. Get an admin to cancel/re-date it to the proposed 2026-10-19 → 2026-12-22, and chase the Laser Cut queue at LASER-01, which is where both late orders are sitting. WO-2026-00001 also carries a **blocking** pending engineering change, ECO-2026-00001 (submitted, high priority, "continue_old") — that one needs an engineering decision and is the real blocker there.
